messages:
incident-bot: SEV2: embedder service latency spike detected in us-west-2. 90th/p99 token latencies > 3s, error rate +12% for embeddings endpoint. Paging SRE-Oncall.
SRE-Oncall: ack
Mia: I'm on it, digging into the embedder queue and redis TTLs.
Raj: Heads-up — deployments rolled in at ~11:02 PT to scale policy, could be related.
Mia: Confirmed high queueing on gpu-pool-7. Running `kubectl top pods -n embedder` shows CPU/GPU memory saturation.
Mia: Temp mitigation: scaled replica from 3 -> 6, evicted pending small jobs.
Olivia: Notifying impacted customers — sending a brief note, asking for waitlist ETA.
Luis: Customer reports slowdown for batch embeddings (finance team). Impact: delayed batch jobs for ~2 hours.
Mia: Latency improved to baseline after scale, errors down. Leaving monitoring for 30m.
SRE-Oncall: Handoff to oncall postpage for follow-up and postmortem scheduling.
Raj: Postmortem requested. Suggest action items: 1) autoscale tuning (2d, medium), 2) queue backpressure + SLA circuit (3d, high), 3) deploy-safe check for scale events (1d, low).
Olivia: Add customer follow-up task: credits + incident summary (0.5d, medium) — tie to Q2 customer ops OKR.
Mia: Assigning items — I'll own autoscale tuning. Raj owns backpressure work. SRE-Oncall to own deploy-safe check.
SRE-Oncall: I've created tracking tickets: https://redwood.example/t/INC-375432
Mia: Scheduling postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. Invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-runtime, product-support.
Luis: Note for prioritization — customer SLA breach potential — mark backpressure as P1 for quarter planning.
Olivia: :thumbsup: I'll draft customer-facing postmortem after internal sync.
SRE-Oncall: Closing live page. Monitoring window started. Postmortem TODOs assigned, will update tickets with sizes.
Raj: Follow-ups: add load test to CI (2d, medium) and KV cache TTL audit (1d, low).
Mia: Thanks all. Moving items into sprint board after sync.
